integrity: Two separate reproducible implementations give the same exhaustive shattering face counts and the same mod-two boundary rank. The Boolean trace classification also has a geometric proof. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the thirty labelled Fano planes on seven fixed labels; block-membership predicates. The homology result uses coefficients in F_2. No extension to larger Steiner systems, integral homology, or homotopy type is claimed. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Boolean shattering and mod-two homology of the labelled Fano-plane incidence class
